mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wkf_supply_request ( id, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, version, bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, category_enum, item_table, item_quantity, total_quantity, item_id, unit_code, occurrence_time, supplier_id, source_location_id, purpose_location_id, applicant_id, end_time, lot_number, trace_no, price, total_price, remake ) SELECT #{detail.id}, m.tenant_id, NOW(6), NOW(6), m.created_by, m.updated_by, 0, 0, m.bus_no, m.type_enum, m.status_enum, m.category_enum, 'med_medication_definition', #{detail.quantity}, #{detail.quantity}, IFNULL(#{detail.itemId}, '0'), '-', m.occurrence_time, m.supplier_id, m.source_location_id, m.purpose_location_id, m.applicant_id, #{detail.expireDate}, #{detail.batchNo}, #{detail.traceNo}, #{detail.unitPrice}, #{detail.totalAmount}, #{detail.itemRemark} FROM wkf_supply_request m WHERE m.id = #{orderId} AND m.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.bus_no AS pharmacyId, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id) AS seqNo, NULLIF(d.item_id, '0') AS itemId, md.name AS drugName, md.total_volume AS spec, md.manufacturer_text AS manufacturer, d.item_quantity AS quantity, d.price AS unitPrice, d.total_price AS totalAmount, d.lot_number AS batchNo, d.trace_no AS traceNo, d.end_time AS expireDate, d.remake AS itemRemark FROM wkf_supply_request d JOIN wkf_supply_request m ON m.bus_no = d.bus_no AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition md ON md.id = d.item_id AND md.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.id = #{orderId} AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.item_quantity > 0 AND d.type_enum IN ('PHARMACY_STOCK_IN', 'INVENTORY_IN') ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id
mapper.update: UPDATE wkf_supply_request d JOIN wkf_supply_request m ON m.bus_no = d.bus_no AND m.is_deleted = 0 SET d.is_deleted = 1, d.deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, d.deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, d.updated_at = #{deletedAt}, d.updated_by = #{deletedBy}, d.version = d.version + 1 WHERE m.id = #{orderId} AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.item_quantity > 0 AND d.type_enum IN ('PHARMACY_STOCK_IN', 'INVENTORY_IN')
